"""Alias bindings through composed pipes and richer transition guards."""
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
import kit

TYPES = [
    {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"},
    {"name": "I", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
    {"name": "AL", "kind": "alias", "target": "I"},
    {"name": "ARR", "kind": "array", "element": "AL", "size": 2},
    {"name": "ARAL", "kind": "alias", "target": "ARR"},
    {"name": "M", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 4},
    {"name": "ST", "kind": "enum", "values": ["A", "B", "C"]},
]
MODULES = [
    {"name": "E", "params": [["v", "ARAL"], ["msg", "M"], ["st", "ST"], ["n", "I"]],
     "result": ["r", "B"],
     "requires": ["all", "x", ["var", "v"], ["lt", ["var", "x"], ["const", "I", 10]]]},
    {"name": "F", "params": [["q", "AL"], ["w", "ARR"]], "result": ["r", "B"],
     "requires": ["and", ["ne", ["var", "q"], ["const", "AL", 7]],
                  ["eq", ["index", ["var", "w"], 1], ["const", "I", 5]]]},
    {"name": "G", "params": [["z", "AL"]], "result": ["r", "B"],
     "requires": ["match", ["var", "z"], "[0-4]"]},          # ill-typed on purpose
]
MODULES[2]["requires"] = ["ge", ["var", "z"], ["const", "AL", 3]]
PIPES = [
    {"target": "E", "filter": "F", "bind": {"q": "n", "w": "v"}},
    {"target": "F", "filter": "G", "bind": {"z": "q"}},
]
MACHINE = {"states": ["A", "B", "C"], "initial": "A", "state_param": "st",
           "message_param": "msg",
           "transitions": [
               {"from": "A", "to": "B", "command": "p", "cost": 4,
                "when": ["match", ["var", "msg"], "[a-c]*"]},
               {"from": "B", "to": "C", "command": "q", "cost": 2,
                "when": ["implies", ["eq", ["var", "st"], ["const", "ST", "C"]],
                         ["const", "B", True]]},
               {"from": "A", "to": "C", "command": "r", "cost": 30, "when": None},
           ]}
campaign = {"types": TYPES, "modules": MODULES, "calls": [], "pipes": PIPES,
            "entries": ["E"], "machine": MACHINE, "runs": []}
out, plan = kit.plan_for(campaign)
print(plan)
assert plan["modules"] == ["G", "F", "E"]
# v: alias array of 2 alias ints (width 1 each) -> ids x0..x3; msg x4..x8; st x9; n x10; r x11; flag x12
assert [s[0] for s in plan["slots"]] == ["x1", "x2", "x5", "x6", "x7", "x8", "x9", "x10", "x11"]
assert plan["flag"] == "x12" and plan["variables"] == 13
assert plan["types"] == ["ARR", "ARAL", "AL", "M", "ST"], plan["types"]

def ktest(v0=1, v1=5, msg="ab", st=0, n=1, r=0, flag=0):
    chars = [ord(c) for c in msg] + [0] * (4 - len(msg))
    values = [v0, v1] + chars + [st, n, r]
    objs = [(name, kit.leaf(width, value)) for (name, path, width), value in
            zip(plan["slots"], values)]
    objs.append((plan["flag"], bytes([flag])))
    return kit.encode(objs)

campaign["runs"] = [
    {"entry": "E", "ktest": ktest()},                                  # ok
    {"entry": "E", "ktest": ktest(flag=1)},                             # attestation mismatch
    {"entry": "E", "ktest": ktest(n=7, flag=1)},                        # F rejects
    {"entry": "E", "ktest": ktest(v1=4, flag=1)},                       # F rejects via w[1]
    {"entry": "E", "ktest": ktest(v0=20)},                              # entry predicate false
    {"entry": "E", "ktest": ktest(msg="zz", st=2, flag=1)},             # G rejects (z=1 -> no [0-4])
]
result = kit.run_cli(campaign)
for record, run in zip(result["records"], campaign["runs"]):
    print(record)
statuses = [r["status"] for r in result["records"]]
assert statuses[0] == "READY"
assert statuses[1] == "INVALID_TEST"
assert statuses[2] == "FILTERED"
assert statuses[3] == "FILTERED"
assert statuses[4] == "FILTERED"
print(result["corpus"])
inputs = result["corpus"][0]["inputs"]
assert inputs == {"v": [1, 5], "msg": "ab", "st": "A", "n": 1}, inputs
# the guard for A->B matches "ab" against [a-c]*, so the preamble exists
print(result["corpus"][0]["commands"], result["corpus"][0]["cost"])
PYEOF
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 t_final.py
